info.title: Misinformation Interventions (v3.1) - coding API
info.description: The scheme and criteria routes of the Coding Studio app. The record and metric schemas mirror the agent bundle's json-schema.json.

get.summary: The active project: id, name, path and scheme summary.

put.summary: Replace the coding scheme (whole document, validated).

get.summary: The scheme's fields, one entry per field.

post.summary: Add or update one field, by name.

get.summary: The abstract and full-text exclusion criteria.

put.summary: Replace the abstract and full-text criteria.

Record.title: Misinformation Interventions (v3.1)
Record.description: One coded record: one experiment, its study-level fields and its metrics array.

Study_ID.title: Study ID
Study_ID.description: Study ID — Unique ID string, [Author][Year]_Exp[1-9]. Required.

Parent_Study_ID.title: Parent Study ID
Parent_Study_ID.description: Parent Study ID — Study_ID of the record one level up in the hierarchy (experiment -> paper/study). Null for a top-level record.  The per-record aggregation level was removed on 2026-09-17; every extraction record now describes one experiment and carries its own DV contrasts.

Publication.title: Publication
Publication.description: Publication — Merged publication form (one moderator). Controlled vocabulary: paper_peer_reviewed, paper_unreviewed, thesis, dissertation, preprint, working_paper, conference_paper, unpublished_manuscript, report. Splits `paper` into peer-reviewed vs unreviewed.

DOI.title: DOI
DOI.description: DOI — Digital Object Identifier, or null.

Authors.title: Authors
Authors.description: Authors — Author names (Last, First), semicolon-separated. Required.

Title.title: Title
Title.description: Title — Title of the paper. Required.

Study_Description.title: Study Description
Study_Description.description: Study Description — 2-sentence description of the study design and primary aim. Required.

N_Recruited.title: N Recruited
N_Recruited.description: N Recruited — Number of participants recruited before exclusions, or null.

N_Analyzed.title: N Analyzed
N_Analyzed.description: N Analyzed — Final analyzed sample size, or null.

N_Reported_Per_Condition.title: N Reported Per Condition
N_Reported_Per_Condition.description: N Reported Per Condition — 1=cell sizes explicitly reported, 0=not reported (must be inferred), null=unclear.

N_Inference_Method.title: N Inference Method
N_Inference_Method.description: N Inference Method — 1=Reported, 2=Equal split of total N, 3=Other (specify in Rationale_Notes).

Age_Mean.title: Mean Age
Age_Mean.description: Mean Age — Numeric mean age, or null (leave null when only a median/range/category is reported).

Age_SD.title: Age SD
Age_SD.description: Age SD — Standard deviation of age, or null.

Age_Group.title: Age Group
Age_Group.description: Age Group — 1=Children, 2=Adolescents, 3=Adults, 4=Mixed. Null if cannot be determined.

Gender_Ratio.title: Gender Ratio
Gender_Ratio.description: Gender Ratio — Object mapping gender labels to percentages or counts, e.g. {"female": 59, "male": 40, "non-binary": 1}; null if not reported.

Covariates.title: Covariates
Covariates.description: Covariates — Array of objects listing variables controlled for, [{"covariate": string, "dv_name": string, "r_val": number|null}]. Empty array if none.

Country.title: Countries
Country.description: Countries — Array of country strings, e.g. ["USA", "UK"]. Empty array if not reported.

Sample_Region.title: Sample Region
Sample_Region.description: Sample Region — Region/description when Country is not applicable (e.g. "international English-speaking", "Sub-Saharan Africa").

International_Sample.title: International Sample
International_Sample.description: International Sample — 1=sample spans multiple countries, 0=single country, null=unclear.

dataset_availability_status.title: Dataset Availability Status
dataset_availability_status.description: Dataset Availability Status — 1=Open URL, 2=Upon request, 3=Not available, 4=Not stated.

data_url.title: Data URL
data_url.description: Data URL — Direct URL to the dataset, or null.

data_repository.title: Data Repository
data_repository.description: Data Repository — Repository name/ID (e.g. OSF ujwy3, Dryad, Zenodo), or null.

data_available.title: Data Available (derived)
data_available.description: Data Available (derived) — Derived, not paper-coded: 1 when a harmonized participant-level dataset exists in `Datasets/<Study Key>/`, else 0. Populated by the reanalysis / analysis-suite scripts (`Scripts/suite_common.py:_data_available_map`).

code_available.title: Code Available
code_available.description: Code Available — 1=analysis code available, 0=not, null=not stated.

preregistration_url.title: Preregistration URL
preregistration_url.description: Preregistration URL — URL of the preregistration, or null.

ethics.title: Ethics Approval
ethics.description: Ethics Approval — 0=No mention, 1=Mentioned, 2=Institution named, 3=Institution and protocol number.

consent_reported.title: Consent Reported
consent_reported.description: Consent Reported — 1=informed consent reported, 0=not, null=not stated.

n_arms.title: Number of Arms
n_arms.description: Number of Arms — Number of independent experimental groups/conditions.

design_factors.title: Design Factors
design_factors.description: Design Factors — Array of manipulated factors, e.g. ["inoculation", "misinformation"] or ["credibility_badge", "social_norm"].

factor_levels.title: Factor Levels
factor_levels.description: Factor Levels — Array of objects, [{"factor": string, "levels": [string]}].

clustering.title: Clustering
clustering.description: Clustering — Clustering/random effects structure, e.g. "standard errors clustered by post", or null.

Intervention_Type.title: Intervention Type
Intervention_Type.description: Intervention Type — Multi-label list of intervention types from the merged vocabulary: inoculation, prebunking_warning, lateral_reading, credibility_labels, media_literacy_tips, fact_checking_training, openmindedness_intervention, debunking_and_rebuttals, community_correction, accuracy_prompts, friction, social_norms, platform_exposure_reduction, other. Multi-type experiments are allowed (e.g. ["inoculation", "friction"]). The former intervention_module field was removed on 2026-09-17; the module-specific coding fields are now implied by these types. Suggested values: inoculation, prebunking_warning, lateral_reading, credibility_labels, media_literacy_tips, fact_checking_training, openmindedness_intervention, debunking_and_rebuttals, community_correction, accuracy_prompts, friction, social_norms, platform_exposure_reduction, other. Any other value is accepted.

Intervention_Type_Detail.title: Intervention Type Detail
Intervention_Type_Detail.description: Intervention Type Detail — REQUIRED when Intervention_Type includes "other"; specify the combined/specific approach. Otherwise null.

Intervention_Topic.title: Intervention Topic
Intervention_Topic.description: Intervention Topic — Topic or domain of the intervention (e.g. vaccines, climate change), or null.

Intervention_Duration.title: Intervention Duration (minutes)
Intervention_Duration.description: Intervention Duration (minutes) — Numeric duration of the intervention in minutes, or null.

Exposure_Schedule.title: Exposure Schedule
Exposure_Schedule.description: Exposure Schedule — 1=Single massed session, 2=Spaced (multiple continuous sessions), 3=Boosted (delayed follow-up session).

Attention_Cues.title: Attention Cues
Attention_Cues.description: Attention Cues — Array of applicable strings: ["Visual Signaling/Highlighting", "Explicit Ignore Instructions", "Physiological/Emotional Focus"]. Suggested values: Visual Signaling/Highlighting, Explicit Ignore Instructions, Physiological/Emotional Focus. Any other value is accepted.

Media_Support.title: Media Support
Media_Support.description: Media Support — Array of applicable strings: ["Model teaching", "Visual aids"]. Suggested values: Visual aids, Video, Audio, Text, Interactive/gamified, Model teaching, Physical materials, Other. Any other value is accepted.

Comm_Strategies.title: Communication Strategies
Comm_Strategies.description: Communication Strategies — Array of applicable strings: ["Interview techniques", "Sketching/narrative", "Verbal labelling"]. Suggested values: Sketching/narrative, Verbal labelling, Interview techniques, Group discussion, Debate, Other. Any other value is accepted.

Practice_Strategy.title: Practice Strategy
Practice_Strategy.description: Practice Strategy — Array of applicable strings: ["Recall tests", "Easy-to-hard sequencing"]. Suggested values: Recall tests, Easy-to-hard sequencing, Classification/sorting, Compare-and-contrast, Self-explanation/reflection, Guided practice, Feedback-based practice, Media production, Other. Any other value is accepted.

Stimuli_Topic.title: Stimuli Topic
Stimuli_Topic.description: Stimuli Topic — Topic or domain of the stimuli, or null.

Rationale_Notes.title: Rationale Notes
Rationale_Notes.description: Rationale Notes — Brief note on inferred values, group-size inference, and effect-size conversions. Empty string if none.

Fulltext_Exclusion_Criterion.title: Full-text exclusion criterion (C1-C4)
Fulltext_Exclusion_Criterion.description: Full-text exclusion criterion (C1-C4) — Leave EMPTY when the study meets every inclusion criterion. Otherwise list the unmet criterion/criteria: C1 = No misinformation intervention; C2 = No control/comparison group; C3 = Not English; C4 = Not a primary experimental study. A study that fails a criterion is STILL fully coded, harmonized and reproduced as normal.

Corresponding_Author_Name.title: Corresponding author (name)
Corresponding_Author_Name.description: Corresponding author (name) — Name of the author the paper directs correspondence to, e.g. "Jane Roe". Empty when the paper names no corresponding author. Recorded separately from the address in 'Corresponding_Author_Email'.

Corresponding_Author_Email.title: Corresponding author (email)
Corresponding_Author_Email.description: Corresponding author (email) — E-mail address of the corresponding author, as printed in the paper. Empty when no address is printed or none could be resolved to the corresponding author.

Corresponding_Author_Source.title: Corresponding author (source)
Corresponding_Author_Source.description: Corresponding author (source) — Where the corresponding author was read from, e.g. "pdf: correspondence note, p. 1" or "openalex: corresponding_author_ids".

Fully_Within.title: Fully within (single arm)
Fully_Within.description: Fully within (single arm) — True when the experiment has no control arm, so it is excluded from every pooled product by default.

Manipulation_Strategy.title: Manipulation Strategies
Manipulation_Strategy.description: Manipulation Strategies — Verbatim list of techniques refuted, e.g. ["Ad Hominem", "False Cause", "Bandwagon", "Emotional storytelling", "Fake experts", "Naturalistic fallacy", "Conspiracy theories", "False balance"].

Active_vs_Passive.title: Active vs Passive
Active_vs_Passive.description: Active vs Passive — 1=Passive inoculation (text reading, video viewing), 2=Active inoculation (gamified interactive roleplay), 3=Mixed.

Perspective_Taking.title: Perspective Taking
Perspective_Taking.description: Perspective Taking — 0=None/neutral, 1=Defender perspective, 2=Misinformation creator/evil perspective (e.g. Bad News game), 3=Both.

Technique_Count.title: Number of Techniques
Technique_Count.description: Number of Techniques — Number of manipulation techniques explicitly taught/refuted, or null.

Technique_Taxonomy.title: Standardized Technique Taxonomy
Technique_Taxonomy.description: Standardized Technique Taxonomy — Standardized controlled names: ["emotional_manipulation", "fake_experts", "conspiracy", "polarization", "amplification", "trolling", "naturalistic_fallacy", "ad_hominem", "false_dichotomy", "coherence_break", "discrediting", "scapegoating", "false_balance"]. Suggested values: emotional_manipulation, fake_experts, conspiracy, polarization, amplification, trolling, naturalistic_fallacy, ad_hominem, false_dichotomy, coherence_break, discrediting, scapegoating, false_balance, conjunction_fallacy, impersonation. Any other value is accepted.

Refutation_Present.title: Refutation Present
Refutation_Present.description: Refutation Present — 1=Explicit refutation included, 0=Threat forewarning only, null=Unclear.

Immunizing_Message_Length_Words.title: Immunizing Message Length (words)
Immunizing_Message_Length_Words.description: Immunizing Message Length (words) — Word count of the inoculation/immunizing text, or null.

Booster_Session_Administered.title: Booster Session Administered
Booster_Session_Administered.description: Booster Session Administered — 0=No booster, 1=Booster administered at follow-up.

Booster_Content.title: Booster Content
Booster_Content.description: Booster Content — Description of any delayed booster session content, or null.

Longevity_Test_Delay_Days.title: Follow-up Delay (Days)
Longevity_Test_Delay_Days.description: Follow-up Delay (Days) — Days between inoculation and delayed post-test, or 0 if immediate only.

Verification_Strategy_Type.title: Strategy Taught
Verification_Strategy_Type.description: Strategy Taught — List of verification heuristics taught: ["lateral_reading", "reverse_image_search", "click_restraint", "wikipedia_source_tracking", "original_context_tracing", "source_credibility_check", "fact_checking_site_use", "CRAAP_checklist"].

Educational_Format.title: Format of Instruction
Educational_Format.description: Format of Instruction — 1=Classroom curriculum/course modules (teacher modeling and guided practice), 2=Short standalone instructional video, 3=Gamified interactive learning module, 4=Prompt/pop-up nudge during browsing, 5=Written guidelines/cheatsheet, 6=Self-guided web platform, 7=Other.

Instructional_Duration_Minutes.title: Instruction Duration (Minutes)
Instructional_Duration_Minutes.description: Instruction Duration (Minutes) — Total exposure in minutes (or estimate for a curriculum).

Assessment_Paradigm.title: Assessment Paradigm
Assessment_Paradigm.description: Assessment Paradigm — 1=Technique-adoption paradigm (authentic web evaluation with screen recording/digital trace), 2=Controlled website credibility judgment task, 3=Self-reported verification-strategy usage, 4=Knowledge/skill assessment quiz.

Tracked_Behavioral_Indicators.title: Tracked Web Navigation Behaviors
Tracked_Behavioral_Indicators.description: Tracked Web Navigation Behaviors — List of tracked metrics: ["opened_new_tabs", "search_engine_queries", "time_on_source_domain", "external_credibility_references"].

Target_Audience_Level.title: Target Population
Target_Audience_Level.description: Target Population — 1=Middle/high-school students, 2=College/university students, 3=General adult public, 4=Older adults, 5=Professionals (e.g. teachers, journalists).

Intervention_Source_Concept.title: Source Concept
Intervention_Source_Concept.description: Source Concept — 1=Sourcing, 2=Lateral Reading, 3=Both/Mixed. Sourcing = leaving the text to assess author/publisher credibility via third-party sources.

Search_Task.title: Search Task
Search_Task.description: Search Task — Description of the search/evaluation task participants completed, or null.

Training_Strategies.title: Training Strategies
Training_Strategies.description: Training Strategies — Array: ["Explicit strategy instruction", "Modeling/demonstration", "Scaffolded practice", "Feedback", "Group discussion"].

Tips_Content_Checklist.title: Specific Tips Included
Tips_Content_Checklist.description: Specific Tips Included — Subset of tips: ["be_skeptical_of_headlines", "inspect_the_url", "investigate_the_source", "watch_for_unusual_formatting", "check_the_photos_images", "inspect_dates", "check_evidence_and_references", "cross_check_other_reports", "check_if_satire", "consider_the_source", "look_for_expert_consensus"].

Delivery_Channel.title: Delivery Channel
Delivery_Channel.description: Delivery Channel — 1=Static graphic/infographic embedded in feed/survey, 2=Platform advertisement/sponsored post (e.g. Meta tips campaign), 3=Text message/ WhatsApp micro-course, 4=Print pamphlet/flyer, 5=Short video clip, 6=Other.

Exposure_Frequency.title: Delivery Schedule
Exposure_Frequency.description: Delivery Schedule — 1=Single one-off exposure, 2=Multi-day repeated micro-lessons (e.g. 5-day SMS), 3=Always-accessible sidebar/guide.

Target_Sample_Literacy.title: Target Sample Demographics
Target_Sample_Literacy.description: Target Sample Demographics — 1=General urban/internet users, 2=Rural / lower education and digital literacy population, 3=Mixed.

Discernment_vs_General_Skepticism.title: Evaluated Discernment Effect
Discernment_vs_General_Skepticism.description: Evaluated Discernment Effect — 1=Selective discernment increased (lower belief/sharing of false, preserved belief of true), 2=General skepticism induced (decreased belief in both true and false), 3=No significant effect.

Tip_Topic_Specific.title: Topic-Specific vs General
Tip_Topic_Specific.description: Topic-Specific vs General — 1=Generic/topic-agnostic tips, 0=Topic-specific tips, null=Unclear.

Training_Focus.title: Training Focus
Training_Focus.description: Training Focus — 1=Claim/fact verification, 2=Source verification, 3=Both claim and source, 4=Other.

Training_Format.title: Training Format
Training_Format.description: Training Format — 1=Direct instruction, 2=Modeling/demonstration, 3=Scaffolded practice with feedback, 4=Gamified practice, 5=Self-directed materials, 6=Mixed.

Transfer_Task.title: Transfer Task
Transfer_Task.description: Transfer Task — Description of any novel-context transfer task, or null.

Feedback_Provided.title: Feedback Provided
Feedback_Provided.description: Feedback Provided — 1=Yes (corrective/elaborated feedback during practice), 0=No, null=Unclear.

Mechanism.title: Mechanism
Mechanism.description: Mechanism — 1=Actively open-minded thinking (AOT) training, 2=Consider-the-opposite/ counterargument generation, 3=Perspective-taking induction, 4=Intellectual-humility training, 5=Values affirmation, 6=Reflection/ metacognitive prompt, 7=Other.

Target_Response.title: Target Response
Target_Response.description: Target Response — 1=Belief updating/receptivity to correction, 2=Myside bias reduction, 3=Sharing behaviour, 4=Openness attitudes, 5=Multiple.

Session_Structure.title: Session Structure
Session_Structure.description: Session Structure — 1=Single brief exercise, 2=Multi-session training, 3=Integrated into curriculum, 4=Booster session.

Outcome_Measures.title: Outcome Measures
Outcome_Measures.description: Outcome Measures — Array, e.g. ["AOT scale", "receptiveness to opposing views", "belief accuracy", "sharing intentions"].

Refutation_Type.title: Refutation Strategy Type
Refutation_Type.description: Refutation Strategy Type — 1=Topic rebuttal / factual debunking (correcting facts directly), 2=Technique rebuttal (exposing rhetorical tactics/fallacies), 3=Combined topic and technique rebuttal.

Correction_Structure_Steps.title: Four-Step Structure Compliance
Correction_Structure_Steps.description: Four-Step Structure Compliance — Subset of the 4 debunking steps present: ["fact_first_statement", "salience_warning_pre_exposure", "misinformation_specification_and_flaw_explanation", "alternative_causal_explanation"].

Alternative_Causal_Explanation_Present.title: Alternative Causal Explanation Present
Alternative_Causal_Explanation_Present.description: Alternative Causal Explanation Present — 1=Explicit alternative causal model provided, 0=Simple retraction/negation only, null=Unclear.

Correction_Source.title: Source of Debunking
Correction_Source.description: Source of Debunking — 1=Professional independent fact-checker, 2=Government/public-health institution, 3=Peer/social correction (user comment), 4=Algorithmic/ platform system message, 5=Anonymous/unattributed source, 6=Trusted messenger (e.g. local health worker), 7=Other.

Timing_Relative_to_Misinformation.title: Timing of Correction
Timing_Relative_to_Misinformation.description: Timing of Correction — 1=Immediate correction (same exposure instance), 2=Delayed correction (subsequent session/turn), 3=Pre-exposure rebuttal.

Misinformation_Continued_Influence_Asses.title: Continued Influence Effect (CIE) Measured
Misinformation_Continued_Influence_Asses.description: Continued Influence Effect (CIE) Measured — 1=Yes (open-ended inferential reasoning/scenario comprehension), 0=No (isolated item belief/accuracy rating only).

Repeated_Correction.title: Repeated Correction
Repeated_Correction.description: Repeated Correction — 1=Yes (same correction delivered more than once), 0=No, null=Unclear.

Threat_to_Worldview.title: Identities/Worldviews Threat
Threat_to_Worldview.description: Identities/Worldviews Threat — 1=Yes (correction challenges a salient identity/worldview), 0=No, null=Unclear.

Crowd_Mechanism.title: Crowd Mechanism
Crowd_Mechanism.description: Crowd Mechanism — 1=Community notes/context annotations, 2=Peer comment correction, 3=Collective intelligence/judgment platform, 4=Crowd flagging/reporting, 5=Collective evaluation task, 6=Other.

Visibility.title: Correction Visibility
Visibility.description: Correction Visibility — 1=Visible to all users, 2=Visible only to a subgroup, 3=Collapsed/behind a click, null=Unclear.

Rating_System.title: Credibility System
Rating_System.description: Credibility System — 1=Continuous journalistic index (e.g. NewsGuard 0-100), 2=Categorical/ color-coded badge (green trustworthy/red untrustworthy), 3=Binary trust seal/warning shield, 4=Crowdsourced trust metric, 5=The Trust Project transparency indicators, 6=Other.

Unit_of_Evaluation.title: Evaluated Unit
Unit_of_Evaluation.description: Evaluated Unit — 1=Domain/news-outlet level, 2=Specific publication channel/page, 3=Individual author/journalist.

Interface_Integration_Method.title: Interface Integration Method
Interface_Integration_Method.description: Interface Integration Method — 1=Browser extension/add-on in natural browsing, 2=In-feed badge beside the headline, 3=Search-engine results page snippet label, 4=Survey experimental card overlay, 5=Other.

Metric_Transparency_Degree.title: Information Detail Provided
Metric_Transparency_Degree.description: Information Detail Provided — 1=Simple badge/score only, 2=Expandable nutrition label with specific criteria (transparency, corrections, ownership).

Information_Diet_Quality_Assessed.title: Information Diet Quality Assessed
Information_Diet_Quality_Assessed.description: Information Diet Quality Assessed — 1=Yes (tracked domain visits/exposure quality via digital trace), 0=No (isolated headline evaluation only).

Label_Type.title: Label Type
Label_Type.description: Label Type — 1=General warning label (content may be disputed/inaccurate), 2=Specific fact-checking label (fact-checker attribution + rating), 3=Contextual information label (background without rating).

Rating_Granularity.title: Veracity Rating Granularity
Rating_Granularity.description: Veracity Rating Granularity — 1=Binary ("False"/"Disputed"), 2=Graded/multi-level (e.g. False, Partly False, Altered, Missing Context), 3=Numeric scale.

Display_Timing_and_Salience.title: Display Mode
Display_Timing_and_Salience.description: Display Mode — 1=In-line tag below/above headline, 2=Interstitial warning/obscuring overlay (click-through), 3=Post-interaction warning (after share click).

Fact_Checker_Identity_Visible.title: Fact-Checking Source Disclosed
Fact_Checker_Identity_Visible.description: Fact-Checking Source Disclosed — 1=Named independent fact-checker (PolitiFact, Snopes), 2=Platform message ("Independent fact-checkers"), 3=Unspecified source.

Implied_Truth_Effect_Tested.title: Implied Truth Effect Tested
Implied_Truth_Effect_Tested.description: Implied Truth Effect Tested — 1=Yes (tested whether unlabelled false headlines gained spurious accuracy), 0=No (only labelled vs control).

Primary_Outcome_Variable.title: Primary Evaluated Outcome
Primary_Outcome_Variable.description: Primary Evaluated Outcome — 1=Accuracy/veracity judgments, 2=Sharing intentions/click-to-share, 3=Belief in underlying claim, 4=Both accuracy and sharing.

Audience.title: Label Audience
Audience.description: Label Audience — 1=General users, 2=Targeted at sharers, 3=Targeted at consumers, 4=Both.

Prompt_Mechanism.title: Prompt Mechanism
Prompt_Mechanism.description: Prompt Mechanism — 1=Direct headline accuracy evaluation (rate veracity of a single neutral/unrelated headline), 2=Explicit prime/reminder (text prompt reminding user accuracy matters), 3=Educational video/multimedia prime on the value of accurate information, 4=Passive accuracy salience banner/header, 5=Other prompt format.

Evaluation_Item_Veracity.title: Veracity of Prompt Item
Evaluation_Item_Veracity.description: Veracity of Prompt Item — 1=True, 2=False, 3=Neutral/non-political, 4=Both true and false shown, null=Not applicable.

Evaluation_Item_Political_Concordance.title: Political Concordance of Prompt Headline
Evaluation_Item_Political_Concordance.description: Political Concordance of Prompt Headline — 1=Politically concordant, 2=Politically discordant, 3=Politically neutral/apolitical, null=Not applicable.

Prompt_Timing.title: Timing of Prompt
Prompt_Timing.description: Timing of Prompt — 1=Prior to feed browsing task, 2=In-line during feed browsing (periodically), 3=At immediate point of sharing decision.

Delivery_Context.title: Delivery Context
Delivery_Context.description: Delivery Context — 1=Survey/lab simulation (headline-discernment paradigm), 2=Social media platform direct message (field experiment, e.g. Twitter DM), 3=Platform public feed/interstitial.

Number_of_Prompts.title: Prompt Repetition Count
Number_of_Prompts.description: Prompt Repetition Count — Total number of accuracy prompts delivered during the experimental session.

Evaluated_Headline_Domain.title: Evaluated Content Domain
Evaluated_Headline_Domain.description: Evaluated Content Domain — Array of content domains tested, e.g. ["politics", "covid-19", "climate_change", "general_science", "conspiracy"].

Primary_Discernment_Metric.title: Primary Discernment Metric
Primary_Discernment_Metric.description: Primary Discernment Metric — 1=Sharing discernment (Sharing True minus Sharing False), 2=Accuracy discernment (Belief True minus Belief False), 3=Raw false-sharing reduction only, 4=Quality score of shared domains (digital trace data).

Friction_Mechanism.title: Friction Mechanism
Friction_Mechanism.description: Friction Mechanism — 1=Read-before-sharing prompt (open/read article link), 2=Pause-and-think reflection prompt, 3=Second-step confirmation modal (extra click), 4=Cognitive justification requirement (write why true/false), 5=Time delay constraint (mandatory wait timer), 6=Other.

Friction_Modality.title: Modal Interface Type
Friction_Modality.description: Modal Interface Type — 1=Non-blocking warning/banner, 2=Blocking pop-up modal requiring user input, 3=Hard delay timer.

Target_Action.title: Action Subject to Friction
Target_Action.description: Action Subject to Friction — 1=Share/Retweet action, 2=Post creation/submission, 3=External link navigation, 4=Like/Upvote.

Content_Targeting_Rule.title: Targeting Rule for Friction Trigger
Content_Targeting_Rule.description: Targeting Rule for Friction Trigger — 1=Universal friction (all links/shares), 2=Unopened-link trigger only, 3=Suspect/flagged content trigger only.

Primary_Behavioral_Outcome.title: Primary Outcome Metric
Primary_Behavioral_Outcome.description: Primary Outcome Metric — 1=Sharing intention (self-report), 2=Observed platform sharing (digital trace), 3=Link click-through/reading rate, 4=Sharing discernment (true vs. false sharing-rate delta).

Friction_Disclosed.title: Friction Disclosed to User
Friction_Disclosed.description: Friction Disclosed to User — 1=Yes (rationale shown), 0=No (silent friction), null=Unclear.

Norm_Type.title: Social Norm Type
Norm_Type.description: Social Norm Type — 1=Descriptive norm (what most people do), 2=Injunctive norm (what is approved/disapproved), 3=Dynamic norm (trending change in peer behaviour), 4=Combined descriptive and injunctive.

Reference_Group.title: Reference Group Specified
Reference_Group.description: Reference Group Specified — 1=Broad platform peer group, 2=National/fellow-citizen group, 3=Ideological/in-group peers, 4=Unspecified/generic social consensus, 5=Local community.

Delivery_Format.title: Presentation Format
Delivery_Format.description: Presentation Format — 1=Statistical normative statement/banner, 2=Simulated social counter/ upvote ratio, 3=Peer comment feedback prompt, 4=Interactive norm elicitation task.

Primary_Target_Variable.title: Primary Behavioral / Cognitive Outcome
Primary_Target_Variable.description: Primary Behavioral / Cognitive Outcome — 1=Sharing intentions, 2=Belief in misinformation, 3=Flagging/reporting suspicious content, 4=Discernment score.

Ingroup_Congruence.title: In-group Congruence of Norm Source
Ingroup_Congruence.description: In-group Congruence of Norm Source — 1=Ideological in-group source, 2=Out-group/general source, 3=Not applicable, null=Unclear.

Exposure_Mechanism.title: Exposure Mechanism
Exposure_Mechanism.description: Exposure Mechanism — 1=Downranking/demotion in feed or search, 2=Removal/deletion of content, 3=Deplatforming/account removal, 4=Reduced distribution/reach, 5=Warning interruption before exposure, 6=Other.

Platform.title: Platform
Platform.description: Platform — Platform or system (e.g. "Facebook", "Instagram", "Search", "YouTube"), or null.

Targeting_Rule.title: Targeting Rule
Targeting_Rule.description: Targeting Rule — 1=Untrustworthy sources/domains, 2=False content items, 3=Engagement/reach threshold, 4=Universal exposure limit, 5=Other.

Assignment_Level.title: Assignment Level
Assignment_Level.description: Assignment Level — 1=User-level randomization, 2=Cluster/geography randomization, 3=Platform-wide policy, 4=Natural experiment, 5=Other.

Theory_Basis.title: Theory Basis
Theory_Basis.description: Theory Basis — Theory the intervention is based on (e.g. "inoculation theory", "elaboration likelihood", "motivated reasoning", "none stated"), or null.

Intervention_Components.title: Intervention Components
Intervention_Components.description: Intervention Components — Array of applicable strings: ["Correction", "Warning", "Skills training", "Feedback", "Nudge", "Platform downranking/exposure reduction", "Community messaging"]. Suggested values: Corrective information, Threat/forewarning, Refutation, Technique exposure, Narrative/storytelling, Discussion/interaction, Emotion induction/regulation, Source salience, Instruction, Nudge, Feedback, Community messaging, Platform/exposure reduction, Other. Any other value is accepted.

Source_Eval_Strategy.title: Source Evaluation Strategy
Source_Eval_Strategy.description: Source Evaluation Strategy — The strategy taught - e.g. "lateral reading", "click restraint", "source-checking", "fact-checking site use", "CRAAP".

DV_Metrics.title: Effect sizes
DV_Metrics.description: One entry per inferential dependent variable and per reported group contrast. The entries follow the 'DV_Metrics' definition.

Metric.title: Effect sizes
Metric.description: One inferential dependent variable and one group contrast. Every number must be sourced from the paper; a number that is not reported is left null and explained in the missing-metrics reason field.

dv_name.title: DV Name
dv_name.description: DV Name — Name/label of the dependent variable.

dv_domain.title: DV Domains
dv_domain.description: DV Domains — Controlled multi-label list: technique_recognition, credibility, sharing_intention, search_behavior, attitude_policy, trust, media_literacy_attitudes, critical_thinking, other.  The former levels echo_chamber, information_overload, social_norms, behavioral_choice and general_transfer were merged into "other" on 2026-09-17; confidence and affect were merged into "other", engagement_behavior into "sharing_intention", and belief_accuracy into "credibility" on 2026-09-19. Suggested values: technique_recognition, credibility, sharing_intention, search_behavior, attitude_policy, trust, media_literacy_attitudes, critical_thinking, other. Any other value is accepted.

score_types.title: Score Types
score_types.description: Score Types — Controlled multi-label list: separate_true, separate_false, separate_manipulative, separate_nonmanipulative, discernment_difference, composite, signal_detection_auc, signal_detection_d_prime, signal_detection_c, dichotomous_accuracy, continuous_accuracy, proportion, proportion_difference, behavioral_choice, other, count, single_item, behavioral_intention, change_score, signal_detection_other. Suggested values: separate_true, separate_false, separate_manipulative, separate_nonmanipulative, discernment_difference, composite, signal_detection_auc, signal_detection_d_prime, signal_detection_c, dichotomous_accuracy, continuous_accuracy, proportion, proportion_difference, behavioral_choice, other, count, single_item, behavioral_intention, change_score, signal_detection_other. Any other value is accepted.

discernment_defined_as.title: Discernment Defined As
discernment_defined_as.description: Discernment Defined As — How a difference/discernment score is computed, e.g. "manipulative minus non-manipulative", or null.

dv_polarity.title: DV Polarity
dv_polarity.description: DV Polarity — 1=higher score is better/protective, 0=higher score is worse, null=not applicable.

scale_points.title: Scale Points
scale_points.description: Scale Points — Number of response scale points, if applicable.

comparison_label.title: Comparison Label
comparison_label.description: Comparison Label — Label of the specific contrast and timepoint, e.g. "Good Bad Vaxx vs Control (post)".

group1_label.title: Group 1 Label
group1_label.description: Group 1 Label — First group name in the comparison.

group2_label.title: Group 2 Label
group2_label.description: Group 2 Label — Second group name in the comparison.

contrast_type.title: Contrast Type
contrast_type.description: Contrast Type — 1=Primary treatment vs no-treatment control, 2=Treatment vs active/placebo control, 3=Dose-response, 4=Within-person, 5=Factorial main effect, 6=Simple effect, 7=Other, 8=Misinformation vs no misinformation, 9=Informative message vs control, 10=Factorial interaction, 11=Omnibus model term, 12=Moderator main effect, 13=Non-intervention factor.

eligible_primary.title: Eligible Primary
eligible_primary.description: Eligible Primary — 1=eligible primary meta-analytic contrast (intervention vs no-inoculation control), 0=not primary, null=unclear.

timepoint_2.title: Timepoint 2
timepoint_2.description: Timepoint 2 — Second timepoint label, or null for cross-sectional single-time contrasts.

delay_weeks.title: Delay (weeks)
delay_weeks.description: Delay (weeks) — Numeric delay in weeks; null if only immediate effects are reported.

n1i_pre.title: N Pre Group 1
n1i_pre.description: N Pre Group 1 — Pre-test sample size group 1.

m1i_pre.title: Mean Pre Group 1
m1i_pre.description: Mean Pre Group 1 — Pre-test mean group 1.

sd1i_pre.title: SD Pre Group 1
sd1i_pre.description: SD Pre Group 1 — Pre-test SD group 1.

n2i_pre.title: N Pre Group 2
n2i_pre.description: N Pre Group 2 — Pre-test sample size group 2.

m2i_pre.title: Mean Pre Group 2
m2i_pre.description: Mean Pre Group 2 — Pre-test mean group 2.

sd2i_pre.title: SD Pre Group 2
sd2i_pre.description: SD Pre Group 2 — Pre-test SD group 2.

n1i_post.title: N Post Group 1
n1i_post.description: N Post Group 1 — Post-test sample size group 1.

m1i_post.title: Mean Post Group 1
m1i_post.description: Mean Post Group 1 — Post-test mean group 1.

sd1i_post.title: SD Post Group 1
sd1i_post.description: SD Post Group 1 — Post-test SD group 1.

n2i_post.title: N Post Group 2
n2i_post.description: N Post Group 2 — Post-test sample size group 2.

m2i_post.title: Mean Post Group 2
m2i_post.description: Mean Post Group 2 — Post-test mean group 2.

sd2i_post.title: SD Post Group 2
sd2i_post.description: SD Post Group 2 — Post-test SD group 2.

n1i.title: N Group 1
n1i.description: N Group 1 — Sample size group 1 for the tested timepoint (metafor alias).

m1i.title: Mean Group 1
m1i.description: Mean Group 1 — Mean group 1 for the tested timepoint (metafor alias).

sd1i.title: SD Group 1
sd1i.description: SD Group 1 — SD group 1 for the tested timepoint (metafor alias).

n2i.title: N Group 2
n2i.description: N Group 2 — Sample size group 2 for the tested timepoint (metafor alias).

m2i.title: Mean Group 2
m2i.description: Mean Group 2 — Mean group 2 for the tested timepoint (metafor alias).

sd2i.title: SD Group 2
sd2i.description: SD Group 2 — SD group 2 for the tested timepoint (metafor alias).

df_num.title: df Numerator
df_num.description: df Numerator — Numerator df for F-tests.

df_den.title: df Denominator
df_den.description: df Denominator — Denominator df for F-tests.

z_val.title: z Statistic
z_val.description: z Statistic — Exact z statistic (e.g. logistic/ordinal regression).

n_total.title: Total N
n_total.description: Total N — Total N for correlation/statistical fallback conversions.

beta_val.title: Regression Beta
beta_val.description: Regression Beta — Unstandardized or standardized regression coefficient (state which in conversion_method).

beta_se.title: Regression Beta SE
beta_se.description: Regression Beta SE — Standard error of the regression coefficient.

or_ci_low.title: Odds Ratio CI Low
or_ci_low.description: Odds Ratio CI Low — Lower bound of the odds-ratio confidence interval.

or_ci_high.title: Odds Ratio CI High
or_ci_high.description: Odds Ratio CI High — Upper bound of the odds-ratio confidence interval.

p_val.title: p Value
p_val.description: p Value — Exact p-value, or the reported bound when censored.

p_censored.title: p Censored
p_censored.description: p Censored — 1=reported as an inequality (e.g. p<.001), 0=exact value.

eta2_p.title: Partial Eta Squared
eta2_p.description: Partial Eta Squared — Partial eta-squared for ANOVA effects.

eta2_p_ci_low.title: Partial Eta Squared CI Low
eta2_p_ci_low.description: Partial Eta Squared CI Low — Lower bound of the partial eta-squared CI.

eta2_p_ci_high.title: Partial Eta Squared CI High
eta2_p_ci_high.description: Partial Eta Squared CI High — Upper bound of the partial eta-squared CI.

d_ci_low.title: d CI Low
d_ci_low.description: d CI Low — Lower CI bound for d.

d_ci_high.title: d CI High
d_ci_high.description: d CI High — Upper CI bound for d.

g_ci_low.title: g CI Low
g_ci_low.description: g CI Low — Lower CI bound for g.

g_ci_high.title: g CI High
g_ci_high.description: g CI High — Upper CI bound for g.

d_se.title: d SE
d_se.description: d SE — Standard error for d.

g_se.title: g SE
g_se.description: g SE — Standard error for g.

yi.title: Effect Size (yi)
yi.description: Effect Size (yi) — Standardized effect size estimate used for meta-analysis.

vi.title: Effect Size Variance (vi)
vi.description: Effect Size Variance (vi) — Variance of the effect size.

sei.title: Effect Size SE (sei)
sei.description: Effect Size SE (sei) — Standard error of the effect size.

effect_size_type_reported.title: Effect Size Type Reported
effect_size_type_reported.description: Effect Size Type Reported — Which effect size the paper reported - d, g, eta2p, beta, odds_ratio, r, none.

effect_favors.title: Effect Favors
effect_favors.description: Effect Favors — Which group/condition the sign favors (e.g. "treatment", "control", "group1").

effect_direction_meaning.title: Effect Direction Meaning
effect_direction_meaning.description: Effect Direction Meaning — Interpretation of a positive sign (e.g. "positive = treatment reduced misinformation beliefs").

conversion_method.title: Conversion Method
conversion_method.description: Conversion Method — How yi/vi were obtained, e.g. "reported d", "t+n to d", "d to vi formula".

conversion_inputs.title: Conversion Inputs
conversion_inputs.description: Conversion Inputs — Inputs used for conversion, e.g. {"n1i":181,"n2i":199,"t_val":9.2}.

cell_descriptives.title: Cell Descriptives
cell_descriptives.description: Cell Descriptives — Array of objects, one per group-time cell, each {"group": string, "timepoint": string, "n": number|null, "mean": number|null, "sd": number|null}.

missing_metrics_reason.title: Missing Metrics Reason
missing_metrics_reason.description: Missing Metrics Reason — Short explanation when no full descriptives or fallback statistics are available; empty string otherwise.

source_location.title: Source Location
source_location.description: Source Location — Where the statistic is reported in the paper, e.g. "Table 2, p. 7", "Fig. 1", "Sect. 3.2"; empty string when truly absent.

source_quote.title: Source Quote
source_quote.description: Source Quote — Verbatim statistic from the paper, e.g. "d = 0.31, 95% CI [0.12, 0.50]"; must be findable in Text/<Key>.txt after whitespace normalisation.

source_span.title: Source span (PDF rectangle)
source_span.description: Source span (PDF rectangle) — The page and the normalised rectangles of the passage the source quote was taken from.
